provenance.method: Generated for structcorpus from the published yamlprims specification revision 1.4, sections 5.2, 5.4, 6, and 7.1.

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: Ordinary mapping admission at max_mapping_entries 2. Two distinct keys load. A repeated second key is duplicate_key because capacity is still available. A third key is max_mapping_entries, including when the key repeats. A NaN key is invalid_key at completion, including when the mapping is already at the cap and when the value would not resolve. Other budgets stay above the row.
